doc.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003

title: Closing remarks
summary: Thanks, plans to practice on the ship, goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: They couldn’t wait ‘till the end. Right. It was like a jazz club. Well this has been most fascinating for me.
And I really enjoyed — you have a great deal to say and a great way of saying it and I appreciate it.
Well thank you very much. I’ve enjoyed it very much. My pleasure.
And good luck on that big boat coming back. That should be a lot of fun.
Yeah that will be. We’re on — almost in the penthouse.
So I’m just going to practice up there man.
The people are going — you get right out there on the terrace and do that. All right. Well thanks again. And I’ll be listening for your next group, and see you and so forth.
